blocks.content: We have added the getPurpose() method. The user can issue and return the book. So, here we ask if the user wants to issue the book or return the book.
If the purpose of the user equals to issue then, the issueBook() method is returned.
And if the purpose of the user equals to return then, the returnBook() method is returned.
